blockingIssues.researchLocation: synthesisInput — omitted evidence from Research Interpretations
blockingIssues.problem: The filtered input omits that the weeks had different parcel-size mixes and that damage counts also differed across mixes under the same layout. These source-stated limitations are material to assessing whether Q’s lower recorded count establishes a layout benefit; the retained general statement that the report does not isolate the effect does not preserve this evidence.
blockingIssues.sourceQuote: The two weeks used different parcel-size mixes. The report does not isolate the layout effect. During a separate check with the same layout, damaged-parcel counts also differed across parcel-size mixes.
blockingIssues.constraint: Retain the source’s different-mix comparison and same-layout check, without treating either as proof of a causal effect.
